text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You two! The glorious day has arrived! Let 
us sing and dance the night away once 
more!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. So, what are you planning to do 
this time...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The program goes like this— "The Supreme 
Overlord Reaches the Glorious Triple 
Crown!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown!? That's...! ...Even if 
it's just a play, I won't give it up!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I have to agree with Top 
Road-san on this one. You're taking it too 
far..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Of course I know! You are my 
arch-rivals. I fully expect you to reject 
it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no script for this performance. 
Therefore, depending on what you do, even 
my defeat is possible—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even taking all that into account, I'm 
telling you I'm going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Whether it is a birthday or a 
theatrical performance... as long as the 
Triple Crown is at stake, I will not hold 
back!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes... even if you lose, no hard feelings, 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That's the spirit! Drama is 
born only when one struggles against fate—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head out! To my—no, to *our* 
stage!!
